title: Record page: a declared field group whose fields are all empty is not drawn in read mode and not counted by 「显示空字段」
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Found by the #36404 dev (PR #36590, the synthesized 「更多详情」 group's empty field is now revealed and counted by 「显示空字段」), outside that card's scope. Filed by the seat, not claimed. Related: #36404.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## What happens

On the default record page, when every field of a field group that the object declares (`fieldGroups`) is empty, read mode draws nothing for the group, and the 「显示 N 个空字段」 button's count leaves those fields out. Pressing the button does not reveal them. It is the same symptom #36404 fixes for the synthesized 「更多详情」 group, but for a declared group.

## Why it is not fixed in #36404

The quick fix, writing `hideEmpty: false` on the group reference the default page builds, would change how every declared group behaves, which is wider than #36404.

## Ask

1. Reproduce on main after PR #36590: an object with a declared group whose fields are all empty on one record.
2. Make 「显示空字段」 count and reveal a fully empty declared group's fields, without changing how a group with some values draws. Say in the PR what an all-empty group shows before the button is pressed (nothing, or its heading), with the reason.

## Re-check

On such a record in read mode, press 「显示 N 个空字段」: the group and its fields appear and N counts them when this is fixed.
